Veterans Benefits: Ohio fully exempts all military retirement pay, including SBP annuities, from state income tax with no income or age limit. Veterans rated 100% (including individual unemployability) qualify for the Enhanced Homestead Exemption, removing $58,000 of appraised home value from property tax.

Description: Dayton is a low-cost Ohio city adjacent to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, one of the Air Force's largest installations and home to Air Force Materiel Command, AFRL, and the aerospace-medicine and intelligence enterprise. It offers the in-city Dayton VA Medical Center, very affordable housing, Ohio's full exemption of military retirement pay, a perfect HRC municipal-equality score, and Costco access. The major tradeoff is a high violent-crime rate; summers are humid and winters cold and snowy.
